---
title: "Leading Ladies and Lost Revenue"
description: >-
  A causal analysis of whether casting a woman in the leading role changes a film's
  worldwide box-office revenue. Films are matched with propensity score weighting on
  genre, budget, release timing and a constructed star-power metric, with sentiment
  analysis of descriptions and taglines. IMDb rating serves as a robustness check.
